title: Perform a Go module upgrade
description:
Perform a Go module upgrade; review the Dependabot PRs and ensure the completed upgrade closes them.

Currently open Dependabot Go module PR:
- #52: go(deps): bump the all-dependencies group across 1 directory with 12 updates
  https://github.com/jpillora/sshd-lite/pull/52
  Branch: dependabot/go_modules/all-dependencies-1962b378ff

Recheck open Dependabot PRs when starting, since the list and required versions may change. Review the grouped upgrades and relevant release notes, consolidate the applicable Go module updates, resolve compatibility changes and regenerate go.mod/go.sum using normal module tooling. Preserve the single-module layout; do not introduce go.work or nested go.mod files.

Validate with build, tests, race tests, vet and Linux/macOS/Windows CI, plus Debian Mosh interoperability where applicable. Account explicitly for the documented preexisting Windows vendored unsafe.Pointer vet findings.

Completion requires the upgrade to be merged and the covered Dependabot PRs to be closed, including #52 if still open. Verify actual PR state rather than assuming a closing reference or overlapping version changes will close a PR automatically. Record any intentionally excluded upgrade and why, and leave genuinely uncovered PRs open with a clear follow-up.
